rationale:
The amended plan is internally consistent, implementation-ready, and consistent with the repository trust model. All material judgments follow.

TWO-PHASE PIVOT: The DISCOVERY-001 resolution is correct. Phase A is pure docs/registry data under the sitting v15 authority — no woven edits, no code, no package dirs, existing gates fully green — and Phase B is a single atomic PR carrying the woven-input edits, governing_authority updates, same-PR re-weave, pivot, supersession, and full from-disk re-verification, fail-closed on any partial state leaving v15/authz-008 intact. The coupling evidence is committed byte-identical to the frozen bootstrap-branch original with a bound digest, and Phase A's acceptance re-verifies it before any successor authorization relies on it. The design is satisfiable by construction and no longer self-referentially blocked.

ENFORCEMENT CHAIN E1–E6: All six enforcers are fail-closed with adversarial regression tests. E1: the merge controller is the sole merger; agents and publisher run on separate fresh runners with a schema-and-digest-bound artifact handoff; the phase-aware Eye acceptance is validated at the mutation boundary; the config attestation is run-bound with TTL and single-use nonce; the serialized revalidate-then-merge ceremony closes same-run drift pre-mutation; the controller self-verifies against TRUSTED_CONTROLLER_DIGEST and refuses controller-modified PRs without an Eye-signed transition record; all regressions (lingering-process, toolchain-poison, protected-ref, two-PR stale, TOCTOU, bypass-inheritance through team/role) are specified. E2: authority is anchored out-of-tree at every context; both the gate and the controller independently recompute transition digests from ground truth and refuse mismatch; the monotonic transition_seq closes temporal replay; the custody split (telos-authority-roots vs telos-authority-release) is correct — PR CI reads roots without touching release secrets, and the fork-PR write-token setting is swept. E3: exceptionless with no escape hatch, structurally incapable of the blocker-5 bypass via a separate non-authoritative inventory mode. E4: flag matrix handled; production+unsigned fails; contradiction case blocked. E5: reconcile-and-supersede with verifier enforcement against stale citations. E6: oracle runner requires discrimination not mere execution; the exhaustive closed-domain battery with concealed content-derived ordering is deterministic and non-gameable; the mutation registry is closed with domain-cardinality enforcement, well-formedness post-mutation validation, and two-sided positive/negative discrimination; baseline isolation (identical canonical path, fresh per-run writable surfaces, bwrap confinement) closes the environmental-signal escape class.

SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM — RATIFIED: The settled design is sound. A constrained declarative oracle language in which the invariant is expressed as inspectable predicates the trusted evaluator interprets makes lookup-table oracles structurally inexpressible — an imperative black box cannot be submitted as a conforming oracle document, so the discrimination problem is solved at the language boundary, not by black-box testing. The evaluator's implementation form (WASM component vs frozen-realm Node worker with ambient globals stripped) is a bounded engineering choice, not an architectural question. The fail-closed interim is correctly stated: no new or changed normative oracle may ship until the evaluator's hard merge gate passes (oracle-evaluator-pending blocks enrollment); the compensating adversarial source review + determinized battery are honestly labeled non-authoritative. Correction (d) is not prematurely claimed closed.

SPIKE-PD001-NOLISTENER-COMPLETENESS — RATIFIED: The no-listener architecture is conceptually sound and fail-closed. The kernel-inherited NO_NEW_PRIVS + seccomp-BPF filter installed by a static hermetic launcher as its first executed instruction — before any dynamic byte runs — and inherited un-droppably across every fork/execve in the process tree closes the whole-tree listener capability regardless of what bytes the spawned tools or their loaders contain. The arch-gate kills compat-ABI bypasses; io_uring is denied at ring creation (no inspectable opcode path); close_range scrubs inherited fds; stdio trio type-checking closes pre-bound socket inheritance; the offline/online profile split correctly resolves the netns-vs-egress tension. SIGUSR1 inspector activation is closed via --disable-sigusr1, correctly grounding the 22.14.0 engine floor as distinct from the >=22.12.0 manifest-integrity oracle. The ptrace threat-model scoping is explicitly and honestly recorded as a non-claim rather than overclaimed. The remaining open item is exhaustive enumeration of residual Linux syscall/loader/namespace corners — a bounded platform-engineering completeness audit, not an architectural flaw — with CI eBPF+strace fail-closed detection as the interim. The Gemini referee ruling is advisory and the Eye's ratification at S2/S3 per §6b is the dispositive record.

INSTALL CONTRACT: Honest. The v1 installable artifact is the source release with the operator-provisioned external-tool manifest required before any host binary executes (doctor refuses external-tool-manifest-missing with no TOFU path). The dual checkout/archive modes are non-contradictory and cover the no-git-history case via git-object reconstruction. The clean-room install job proves operability from the assembled tarball. The runtime interval [22.14.0, ceiling] is consistent across engines-parse, launcher, doctor, install docs, and the reconciliation oracle, with a cross-surface regression suite enforcing agreement. The trust-root manifest is operator-supplied out-of-band; no in-tree value is ever consulted as authoritative; the bootstrap fexecve is mutation-point-bound closing the TOCTOU between receipt and execution.

RELEASE PIPELINE: workflow_dispatch-only (no tag-push trigger eliminates off-main workflow substitution at the platform level); all-tags ~ALL ruleset (not a glob — FNM_PATHNAME semantics correctly noted) restricts tag creation to the Eye; draft-first Eye-local ceremony with numeric release-ID binding throughout; Actions disabled and App installations platform-suspended during the exclusive publish interval with denial proven; historical-tag placeholders occupy every existing slot; the bijection sweep covers releases and tags end-to-end; the escrow-and-recovery path is honest about immutable-tag-name retirement semantics.

CUSTODY MODEL: Correctly closed. Split-ruleset design (α safety — empty bypass list, binds everyone; β actor-restriction — bypass list = {controller} post-E1) resolves the combined-ruleset contradiction. The custody-drift oracle covers collaborators, App installations by permission class, and deploy keys across all writer classes; enumeration refused ⇒ fail. The controller's workflows:write scope is correctly recorded in the manifest as necessary for merging PRs that modify .github/workflows/* (Phase B ci.yml, release workflow slice) and does not relax the sole-merger rule.

GOVERNANCE BOOTSTRAP ordering is lawful: Phase A merges under v15 authority (which empowers successor authorization via the regularized change path); E1 lands via the documented exceptional bootstrap merge (one of exactly two enumerated ceremonial merges, both recorded in the step-ledger); from that point every merge is machine-enforced. The pre-activation whitelist is content-addressed with descriptor-bound change-surface constraints; the Eye's signed acceptance binds each PR head to its descriptor in one payload; the controller's diff-to-descriptor predicate enforces the surface constraint deterministically.

No internal contradictions, no unsound designs, no overclaimed non-claims, no deferred items that are architectural flaws. The plan may be implemented as stated.
